text:
andrew_sales: Kicking off POC with FinAssist — they want LLM-based ticket triage + suggested replies. Need to align success criteria, sample data handling, security questionnaire, and sandbox access. Timeline goal: 2 weeks. @tess_se can you lead the technical POC?

tess_se: Yep. Quick checklist: sample prompts/evals, dataset for hallucination/regression tests, connection method (S3 presigned or VPC peering), redaction rules, storage TTL, and latency/cost SLO targets. Can we get an anonymized CSV of ~5k rows to start?

mia_csm: Customer says no PHI in exports. I asked them to provide a redacted export + a synthetic dataset to cover edge cases. I'll follow up and try to get something by EOD tomorrow.

jordan_security: We need the completed security questionnaire before granting sandbox creds. Confirming our baseline: no PHI, no plaintext SSNs. For sandbox we'll offer isolated org, short-lived API tokens, request-level audit logs off by default. If they want S3, require presigned URLs + SSE-KMS + bucket policy denying public access.

tess_se: Draft POC plan: 2 weeks. Week 1: provision sandbox, ingest sample, run 3 eval prompt sets (classification, extract, summarization). Week 2: prompt tuning, perf runs, cost simulations, deliver final report. Draft success criteria: p95 latency <= 300ms (512 tokens), top-1 accuracy >= 85% on labeled eval set, hallucination rate < 2% on OOD prompts, and cost envelope TBD (prefer < $0.60 / 1k tokens for the use case).

andrew_sales: On pricing — they're asking about capped POC price vs pay-as-you-go. Recommend flat POC credit: $5k for 2 weeks to cover infra + engineering time. Easier to sell. Thoughts?

mike_prod: Flat credit makes sense. We can spin a small Dedicated sandbox node to emulate their throughput and isolate metrics. Infra needs: CIDR for VPC peering (e.g. `10.250.0.0/16`), or we can ingest via presigned S3. Also need sample token-length distribution to tune batching.

tess_se: Action items and owners: Mia -> sample + anonymization note (due tomorrow noon). Jordan -> send security questionnaire + minimum controls (EOD). Mike -> provision sandbox infra + token TTL config (24-72h). I'll draft prompts & evals and share.

mia_csm: I'll produce a redaction script and request weakly synthetic rows to cover edge cases. Redaction snippet (will send full script):

```bash
# remove emails and last4 digits of numbers
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,6}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' input.csv | \
sed -E 's/([0-9]{4})$/[REDACTED_LAST4]/g' > input_redacted.csv
```

jordan_security: Also we need proof of deletion policy for any persisted samples, KMS key rotation details, and SOC2 link. I'll post our questionnaire here: https://redwood.internal/sec/questionnaire (internal). Please mark any controls they cannot meet.

deploy-bot: sched:provision sandbox cluster finassist-poc - status: queued

mike_prod: Provisioning update: cluster id `fin-poc-2026-03-20` created, firewall rules staged for 3 IP ranges. Token TTL default set to 72h. If we do presigned S3 ingest, we'll give them a presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-fin-sandbox/sample.csv --expires-in 3600`.

tess_se: Confirming acceptance criteria to hand to customer: p95 <= 300ms, accuracy >= 85% on our labeled eval, integration with their ticketing system (via webhook/JIRA), hallucination <2% and cost target ~ $0.60 / 1k tokens. If any of those are blockers, flag now.

andrew_sales: I'll propose $5k flat POC credit + optional $20k pilot if success criteria met within 30 days. I'll loop legal for an MSA addendum to cover sandbox terms.

jordan_security: Important caveat: if they require processing of real PHI we must switch to Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) — hosted sandbox cannot handle PHI. Flagged as enterprise blocker if they demand PHI.

tess_se: I'll prepare the POC plan doc to send after we receive the sample. Draft eval prompt list: triage classification, extract entities (PII detection + remove), summarize long threads, and reranking suggestions. Add any prompt variants you want me to test.

mike_prod: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate VPC peering with their infra once we have contact IPs and ASN. Also will provide a small cost estimate for Dedicated sandbox GPU hours.

mia_csm: I'll coordinate handoff to FinAssist and expect a reply by tomorrow. Will post sample and redaction confirmation here when received. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
